title: The sprint skill's plan step runs a bug's repro against the goal's design choice before the start gate
goal: The plan step of skills/sprint/SKILL.md says to run a bug's repro against the goal's design choice before the start gate (a repro that plain redact.redact keeps a UUID contradicted the goal that only a live lease keeps one, SP-osevumx6 BG-pqthn333), and notes that a worker whose fix voids the repro cannot replace it with set --repro in its own tree because that refuses a passing command

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('## start',1)[0].lower()
miss=[w for w in ['repro still passes beside the goal'] if w not in s]
sys.exit('not yet: plan section lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
